sections.title: Put the journey together
sections.content: Combine familiar travel vocabulary, present tense, tener que, tener, querer, necesitar and ir a + infinitive to describe the start of a journey.

sections.title: Starting a journey
rows: I have to go to the station.
Tengo que ir a la estación.
I am going to take the train.
We are going to travel today.

items.spanish: Tengo que ir a la estación.
items.english: I have to go to the station.
I am going to take the train.

sections.content: A travel interaction can combine several familiar structures: Tengo que..., Necesito..., Quiero..., Voy a...
